title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet spars with the proud Mr. Darcy in a sharp, funny study of class, marriage, and first impressions in Regency England.

title: Sense and Sensibility
author: Jane Austen
description: Two sisters, one ruled by reason and one by feeling, navigate money, heartbreak, and reputation after their family loses its home.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: An orphaned governess with a fierce sense of self takes a post at Thornfield Hall and uncovers the secret at its heart.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
description: On the Yorkshire moors, the wild bond between Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw wrecks two generations of two families.

title: Great Expectations
author: Charles Dickens
description: Orphan Pip is lifted out of poverty by a mysterious benefactor and learns what his ambition is really costing him.

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
description: Captain Ahab drives the whaling ship Pequod across the oceans in obsessive pursuit of the white whale that maimed him.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: A young man stays beautiful forever while his portrait in the attic quietly records every one of his sins.

title: Crime and Punishment

description: A destitute student in St. Petersburg commits a murder he believes is justified, then cannot escape his own conscience.

title: Anna Karenina
author: Leo Tolstoy
description: A married aristocrat's affair with a dashing officer unravels her life, set against a sweeping portrait of Russian society.

title: Les Misérables

description: Ex-convict Jean Valjean tries to build an honest life while the relentless inspector Javert hunts him across revolutionary France.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
author: Alexandre Dumas
description: Betrayed and imprisoned on the eve of his wedding, Edmond Dantès escapes and returns as a wealthy, patient avenger.

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
description: The four March sisters grow up in Civil War-era New England, each chasing a very different idea of a good life.

title: Middlemarch
author: George Eliot
description: The lives, marriages, and ambitions of a provincial English town intertwine in a wise, detailed study of ordinary idealism.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: Scout Finch watches her father, a small-town Alabama lawyer, defend a Black man falsely accused of a terrible crime.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Nick Carraway is drawn into the glittering, doomed world of his neighbor Jay Gatsby on Long Island in the Jazz Age.

title: Beloved
author: Toni Morrison
description: A formerly enslaved woman in Ohio is haunted, literally, by the child she lost and the past she cannot outrun.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J.D. Salinger
description: Expelled from prep school, sixteen-year-old Holden Caulfield wanders New York for a weekend, alienated and painfully honest.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude

description: Seven generations of the Buendía family rise and fall in the mythic town of Macondo, where the miraculous is routine.

title: The Kite Runner

description: A privileged boy in Kabul betrays his closest friend, and decades later returns to Afghanistan to try to make it right.

title: Life of Pi

description: After a shipwreck, a teenage boy survives 227 days on a lifeboat sharing the ocean with a full-grown Bengal tiger.

title: The Remains of the Day
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
description: An aging English butler takes a road trip and reckons with a lifetime of devotion to a household and a master he never questioned.

title: Mrs Dalloway

description: One June day in 1923, Clarissa Dalloway prepares for a party while memory and the shadow of war move through London.

title: Things Fall Apart

description: Okonkwo, a proud leader in a Nigerian Igbo village, watches his world change as colonial missionaries and rule arrive.

title: Normal People

description: Two Irish teenagers from different social worlds drift together and apart through school, university, and early adulthood.

title: The Hobbit

description: Bilbo Baggins, a comfort-loving hobbit, is swept into a quest with thirteen dwarves to reclaim a treasure guarded by a dragon.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Frodo inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with eight companions to destroy it before the Dark Lord reclaims it.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: An orphan discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard, and begins his first year at Hogwarts School.

title: A Game of Thrones

description: Noble houses of Westeros scheme for the Iron Throne as an ancient threat gathers beyond the northern Wall.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: Kvothe, now a quiet innkeeper, tells the true story of how a gifted orphan became a legend.

title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe

description: Four siblings step through a wardrobe into Narnia, a land locked in endless winter under a White Witch.

title: A Wizard of Earthsea

description: Young Ged, a gifted but proud apprentice, releases a shadow into the world and must hunt it across an archipelago.

title: American Gods

description: Fresh out of prison, Shadow Moon becomes bodyguard to a mysterious old man and is pulled into a war between old and new gods.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Paul Atreides and his family take control of the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the universe's most valuable substance.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
description: As a galactic empire begins to fall, a mathematician devises a plan to shorten the coming dark age from thirty thousand years to one.

title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
description: A gifted child is taken to an orbiting battle school to be trained as humanity's commander against an alien threat.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
description: A washed-up hacker is offered one last job in cyberspace, a heist that will change what intelligence means.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
description: An envoy to the frozen world of Gethen struggles to understand a people who have no fixed gender.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: Stranded alone on Mars after his crew leaves him for dead, botanist Mark Watney has to science his way to survival.

title: Snow Crash

description: A pizza-delivering hacker in a fractured near-future America chases a virus that spreads through both computers and minds.

title: Hyperion
author: Dan Simmons
description: Seven pilgrims, each with a story, journey to the Time Tombs to face the legendary and lethal Shrike.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
description: Moments before Earth is demolished for a hyperspace bypass, Arthur Dent is whisked into space with an alien friend and a towel.

author: George Orwell
description: In a world of constant surveillance and rewritten history, Winston Smith risks everything to think for himself.

title: Animal Farm
author: George Orwell
description: Farm animals overthrow their human owner and build a society of equals, until the pigs begin to rewrite the rules.

title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
description: A society engineered for comfort and stability has traded away freedom, family, and truth, and one outsider notices.

title: Fahrenheit 451

description: Guy Montag's job is burning books, until a curious neighbor makes him question the world he helps to enforce.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
author: Margaret Atwood
description: In the theocratic state of Gilead, Offred is assigned to a Commander's household for one purpose and dreams of escape.

title: The Road

description: A father and son walk south through a burned, ashen America, carrying almost nothing but each other and a fragile hope.

title: Never Let Me Go
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
description: Students at an English boarding school slowly uncover the truth about why they were raised there.

title: The Hunger Games
author: Suzanne Collins
description: Sixteen-year-old Katniss volunteers to take her sister's place in a televised fight to the death.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate a family curse and a spectral hound haunting the Devon moors.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
author: Agatha Christie
description: Snowed in on a luxury train, Hercule Poirot has one night to identify a killer among a carriage full of suspects.

title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
description: Ten strangers are lured to an island, and one by one they begin to die according to an old nursery rhyme.

title: Gone Girl

description: On their fifth anniversary, Amy Dunne vanishes, and her husband Nick becomes the prime suspect in a marriage full of lies.

title: The Big Sleep
author: Raymond Chandler
description: Los Angeles private eye Philip Marlowe is hired by a dying millionaire to deal with his wild daughter's blackmailer.

title: The Maltese Falcon

description: San Francisco detective Sam Spade is pulled into a deadly hunt for a black statuette worth a fortune.

title: The Da Vinci Code
author: Dan Brown
description: A murder in the Louvre sends a Harvard symbologist racing across Europe to decode a secret hidden in art and history.

title: In the Woods

description: A Dublin detective haunted by a childhood mystery is assigned a murder in the very woods where his friends vanished.

title: Rebecca

description: The new Mrs. de Winter arrives at Manderley and finds the house, and her husband, still ruled by the memory of his first wife.

title: Outlander

description: A WWII nurse is swept back to 1743 Scotland, where she must choose between two men and two centuries.

title: The Notebook

description: An elderly man reads a love story to a woman in a nursing home, a summer romance that shaped two lives.

title: Me Before You
author: Jojo Moyes
description: A small-town woman takes a caregiving job for a brilliant, bitter man and changes both their ideas of a good life.

title: Persuasion
author: Jane Austen
description: Eight years after being talked out of marrying the man she loved, Anne Elliot meets Captain Wentworth again.

title: The Time Traveler's Wife

description: Henry has a genetic disorder that flings him through time, and Clare loves him across every jump.

title: All the Light We Cannot See

title: Wolf Hall

title: The Pillars of the Earth

title: The Nightingale

title: Gone with the Wind

title: Dracula

title: Frankenstein

description: Victor Frankenstein brings a creature to life and then abandons it, with tragic consequences for them both.

title: The Shining
author: Stephen King
description: A struggling writer takes a winter caretaker job at the remote Overlook Hotel, and the hotel takes an interest in his son.

title: The Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: A respectable London doctor's experiment releases a violent double, and a lawyer slowly pieces the truth together.

title: The Haunting of Hill House
author: Shirley Jackson
description: Four people gather at a notorious mansion to study its supernatural reputation, and the house begins to study them back.

title: Interview with the Vampire

title: The Turn of the Screw

description: A governess becomes convinced that the two children in her care are haunted by the ghosts of former servants.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind

title: Educated

title: The Diary of a Young Girl

title: A Brief History of Time

description: A physicist explains black holes, the Big Bang, and the nature of time for readers without a science background.

title: Cosmos

description: A guided tour of the universe and of humanity's long effort to understand it, from ancient astronomers to space probes.

title: Silent Spring

description: The landmark 1962 investigation into the harm caused by pesticides, credited with launching the modern environmental movement.

title: The Immortal Life of Henrietta Lacks
author: Rebecca Skloot

title: Born a Crime

title: Becoming
author: Michelle Obama
description: The former First Lady's memoir, from her childhood on Chicago's South Side to her years in the White House.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: A psychologist maps the two systems of thought that drive our judgments, and the predictable ways they go wrong.

title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
author: Jared Diamond
description: An argument that geography and environment, not innate differences, explain why some societies came to dominate others.

title: Into the Wild
author: Jon Krakauer
description: The true story of Chris McCandless, a young man who walked into the Alaskan wilderness in 1992 and did not walk out.

title: The Selfish Gene

description: A classic of popular science that reframes evolution from the point of view of the gene rather than the organism.
